item.title: The homeschooled entrepreneur on a mission to change government
item.description: Robyn Scott was homeschooled in Botswana. Today, she is co-founder and CEO of Apolitical, a government learning platform used by over 250,000 public servants in 160 countries.

item.title: What will it actually take to fix the NHS? Episode 1
item.description: Two East London boys believe they can make more of an impact than the new Labour Government. Over the next 12 months, this Gather documentary series will follow the Healthtech-1 team as they work towards their mission of making the NHS the most advanced healthcare system in the world.
